paragraphs: Abba Yose ben Abaye: Rabbi Yochanan transmitted in his name, Zevachim 97a. There, 25b: Rabbi Yochanan said in Rabbi Yose bar Abba’s name. It seems to me it should read bar Abaye. Examine this carefully.
